result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one restaurant card contains a clearly broken delivery-price value. Some content is partially clipped at the viewport edges, though this appears consistent with horizontal carousels and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid or missing numeric value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee formatting and provide the actual fee, or display a fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable.”

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant card are cut off at the right edge, and the second restaurant card is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation in the screenshot.
issues.suggestion: If these are horizontal carousels, ensure partial cards are clearly intentional and horizontally scrollable; also add sufficient bottom scroll padding so content is not hidden behind the navigation bar.
